taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: KMS decrypt/data-key authority across encryption contexts and services
controls.source_trace: Resolve effective KMS authority and whether trusted encryption context or ViaService constraints bind the intended tenant/workload. Treat encryption context as authenticated metadata, not secret data.
controls.implementation_branch: Encryption context is authenticated additional data, not encrypted secret storage. Follow the exact context supplied to KMS and conditions in both key and identity policies, including grants and service-mediated calls. A caller able to choose a tenant context must still be authorized to use that tenant; mere knowledge of the context is not entitlement.
controls.operational_method: Start from key type and exact API: encryption context applies to supported symmetric encryption operations, not every asymmetric or HMAC operation. Record the literal map sent to Encrypt/Decrypt and the condition/grant used. Distinguish EncryptionContextEquals from EncryptionContextSubset constraints and compare the caller-supplied tenant map with the policy-expected map. A local cryptographic context mismatch is not evidence that IAM separates tenants; inspect the grant/policy path independently.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an owned test key and synthetic ciphertext locally/in an authorized sandbox; compare rightful context and principal with a mismatched tenant context.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: The ability to invoke an SDK or read a key ARN is not decryption authority; cryptographic rejection alone does not test IAM separation.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Constrain principal/service/context authorization and verify legitimate decrypt plus cross-context denial.
